_about: Every Claude call made from this repo carries metadata.user_id = "site:<job>" so the Console's Logs and Usage pages say which job spent the money. A job that is not listed here cannot make a call: the server's llm.ts types `job` as one of these keys (an untagged or misspelled call fails typecheck), and claude-core.mjs / cabin-advisor/claude_bulk.py refuse an unlisted tag at runtime, before any request is sent. Add a line here when you add a call site.

site.news.hubclass: Sort ambiguous news stories onto the per-cruise-line hub pages (prerender pass; cheap model)
site.storm.intel: One factual sentence from a cruise line's storm-advisory page (cheap model)
site.storm.draft: Storm-alert draft for subscribers, reviewed by Mark before it sends
